annotations.title: Send a class enquiry to Jason

description: Passes a class enquiry to Jason Lau by email, the same way as the enquiry form on jasonlau.academy. Use only when a parent (or a student aged 16 or over) asks you to, after they have given every field and explicitly agreed that you send their details to Jason. Never send for a student under 16 contacting Jason themselves; ask them to have a parent get in touch. Jason replies with dates and fees. Set consent_to_email to true only when the person has said yes to sending.

consent_to_email.description: Must be true: the person agreed to send these details to Jason by email.

contact.description: Email address, Telegram username (like @name) or phone number with country code (like +852).

contact_name.description: Name of the person Jason should reply to.

message.description: What the teen is interested in or wants to build, and any questions, in the person's own words.

name: send_enquiry
